effective_rule: 2026-09-25 Comprehensive Rules 702.62, owner can choose whether to cast when last counter removed; suspended card without counters remains exiled and no longer suspended.
source_paid_fixture: Three physically sourced untapped basic lands: Island, Island, Swamp; pay {U}{U} and one generic using Swamp; suspend is a special action from hand not a cast, does not use stack, card in exile with 3 time counters; actual upkeep counter trigger on each of three later upkeeps.

registered_cases.expected: True physical suspend cost paid, three separate upkeeps 3→2→1→0, conditional optional cast from exile in upkeep not constrained by sorcery timing. Creatures put not cast; Lost token from Betrayal cast.
Search may deliberately or necessarily fail to find a creature; spell cast and Lost triggers, no creature moved to battlefield.
Drannith disallows cast from exile after 3rd upkeep, card stays exiled with zero counters and cannot re-trigger on future upkeep.
A spell already cast on the final upkeep under Rule of Law prevents the suspend cast; card stranded in exile with zero counters.
Under 2024+ rules last-counter ability permits owner to decline casting; card remains exiled without counters, despite legal target.
Cast from exile generates Lost spawn; an opponent counters actual spell, it moves to graveyard, no creature enters.

A card with no mana cost cannot be normally cast from hand; suspending is not spell cast and does not increase storm/cascade; a later upkeep free cast if legal is first spell of that turn and has MV0; Keeper trigger would deal zero damage if Keeper present.

limitations: Opponent library is deliberately prearranged external, not a sampled pod.
Nonnative real-game rules and pending triggers are a bounded local trace, not a game engine.
